question: **Direction: Choose the incorrectly spelt word.**
solution:
The correct answer is** "Losare."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **"Losare"** is not a correctly spelt word.
 
• The correct spelling is **"Loser."**
 
• **"Loser"** means a person who is defeated. (हार जाने वाला व्‍यक्ति, असफल व्‍यक्ति)
